value.title: If You're Going To Strike Back...
value.synopsis: Having joined forces with Swen and sworn revenge, Rua agrees to serve as the "Rose Princess" at the birthday festival as part of their plan.

value.title: The Birthday Celebration Begins
value.synopsis: Upon hearing Rua practicing the assigned piece, Nerune rushes into the piano room. Rua, facing Nerune’s hostility, declares that she has no intention of stepping down from the role of the Rose Princess. Finally, the curtain rises on the Birthday Festival.

value.title: Birthday Celebration: Final Day
value.synopsis: While going around distributing roses, Rua runs into Charlotte in the city and learns about the customs the townspeople observe during the Festival of Birth. On the second day of the festival, she browses the market stalls during a brief moment of free time and unexpectedly encounters someone she knows.

value.title: A Yellow Rose, or a White Rose?
value.synopsis: On the final night of the birthday festival, Rua begins her performance. Meanwhile, Nerune is seen having tampered with the stage. Swen appears and quietly informs her that he is fully aware of everything she has done.
